_evidence: 0x0051b1f9 (colour -> hue/saturation/value): reads the three words 0x933a14/0x933a16/0x933a18 (movzx), takes max/min with unsigned compares, stores the max to 0x933a1e and 'cmp esi,0; jne' - a zero maximum (all three words zero) clears 0x933a1c/0x933a1a at block 0x51b237, which fuzzed words never reached. Otherwise saturation = ((max-min) << 14) / max ('div esi', esi != 0), a zero saturation (max == min) clears the hue, else the hue selects the branch whose word equals the max ('cmp si,[..]; jne') and divides by 3*(max-min) != 0 with edx = 0 (no #DE). Each word here is zero in about a third of the cases (all three in about 1/27) and otherwise drawn from 15 small, colour-range, mid and top values, so equal maxima, max == min and every hue branch occur. Plain words: every value valid. Values are synthetic.
